# Each NOW() of the operation was replaced with "2026-01-15T09:00:00Z"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime>, the step's cst:transactionTime. The engine reads no clock.
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  pat:  <https://www.nebularis.org/neuro-semantic/lattice/persistence-store#>

INSERT {
  GRAPH <urn:g:facilities> {
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1-drawdown-1> <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <https://example.org/lending#Drawdown> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1-drawdown-1> <https://example.org/lending#drawdownDate> "2026-03-15"^^xsd:date .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1-drawdown-1> <https://example.org/lending#drawnAmount> 40000000.0 .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <https://example.org/lending#Facility> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#arrangedBy> <https://example.org/lending#branch-london> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#borrower> <https://example.org/lending#acme-foods> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#commitment> 120000000.0 .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#facilityReference> "FAC-2026-001" .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#hasDrawdown> <https://example.org/lending#facility-1-drawdown-1> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#lender> <https://example.org/lending#lender-north> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#lender> <https://example.org/lending#lender-south> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#margin> 3.25 .
  }
  GRAPH ?addGraph {
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1-drawdown-1> <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <https://example.org/lending#Drawdown> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1-drawdown-1> <https://example.org/lending#drawdownDate> "2026-03-15"^^xsd:date .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1-drawdown-1> <https://example.org/lending#drawnAmount> 40000000.0 .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <https://example.org/lending#Facility> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#arrangedBy> <https://example.org/lending#branch-london> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#borrower> <https://example.org/lending#acme-foods> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#commitment> 120000000.0 .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#facilityReference> "FAC-2026-001" .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#hasDrawdown> <https://example.org/lending#facility-1-drawdown-1> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#lender> <https://example.org/lending#lender-north> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#lender> <https://example.org/lending#lender-south> .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <https://example.org/lending#margin> 3.25 .
  }
  GRAPH <urn:g:meta/6> {
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> pat:VersionRow .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> pat:epoch "1"^^xsd:long .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> pat:seq "1"^^xsd:long .
    <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> pat:head <urn:rev:facility-1/1> .
  }
  GRAPH <urn:g:txn> {
    <urn:txn:facility-1-1> pat:rev <urn:rev:facility-1/1> .
    <urn:txn:facility-1-1> pat:requestDigest "bc11607427bf865ace5b42c0545bd3fe8082e3ec45b54c7935be0165e2cd66dc" .
  }
  GRAPH ?logGraph {
    <urn:rev:facility-1/1> <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> pat:Revision .
    <urn:rev:facility-1/1> pat:target <https://example.org/lending#facility-1> .
    <urn:rev:facility-1/1> pat:epoch "1"^^xsd:long .
    <urn:rev:facility-1/1> pat:seq "1"^^xsd:long .
    <urn:rev:facility-1/1> pat:txn ?txnKey .
    <urn:rev:facility-1/1> pat:recordedAt ?now .
    <urn:rev:facility-1/1> pat:asserts ?addGraph .
  }
}
WHERE
  { { FILTER ( ( ( ( isIRI(<https://example.org/lending#facility-1>) && ( datatype("1"^^xsd:long) = datatype("0"^^xsd:long) ) ) && isIRI(<urn:rev:facility-1/1>) ) && isIRI(<urn:txn:facility-1-1>) ) && ( datatype("bc11607427bf865ace5b42c0545bd3fe8082e3ec45b54c7935be0165e2cd66dc") = xsd:string ) ) }
    BIND(IRI(concat(str(<urn:g:txlog/>), substr(str("2026-01-15T09:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime), 1, 7))) AS ?logGraph)
    BIND(IRI(concat(str(<urn:rev:facility-1/1>), "/add")) AS ?addGraph)
    GRAPH <urn:g:dataset>
      { <urn:g:dataset>
                  pat:epoch  "1"^^xsd:long
      }
    FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH <urn:g:meta/6>
                          { <https://example.org/lending#facility-1>
                                      pat:seq  ?any
                          }
                      }
    FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH <urn:g:facilities>
                          { <https://example.org/lending#facility-1>
                                      ?anyP  ?anyO
                          }
                      }
    FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH <urn:g:txn>
                          { <urn:txn:facility-1-1>
                                      pat:rev  ?any
                          }
                      }
    BIND(str(<urn:txn:facility-1-1>) AS ?txnKey)
    BIND("2026-01-15T09:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime AS ?now)
  }
